logp.method_description: Lipophilicity parameter log Po/w of the ruthenium(II) complexes was determined by measuring in duplicate the partition coefficients of the 1-octanol/water system [39]. The complexes were dissolved and diluted to 30 μM in 5 mM Tris–HCl/50 mM NaCl. Equal volumes (4 mL) of the aqueous solution and 1-octanol were shaken mechanically for 5 h. Aliquots were taken from the upper 1-octanol layer and the lower aqueous layer. Ruthenium content was determined by UV–Vis absorption spectroscopy. Lipophilicity parameter log Po/w was expressed as the log of the partion ratio of total ruthenium in 1-octanol to total ruthenium in the aqueous layer.
